description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Ithcasans Yercas)
- Vendor B (Lupol Talthodra)
- Vendor C (Ozvok Drasanmo)
- Vendor D (Vacasoz Oznol)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

Vendor A (Ithcasans Yercas):
  - Vendor A has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor A performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor A does not meet accessibility standards
  - Vendor A has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor A estimates deployment will take 4 months
Vendor B (Lupol Talthodra):
  - Vendor B does not meet accessibility standards
  - Vendor B passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor B is fully compliant with health-data regulations
  - Vendor B allows no customisation
